sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:47757
Court No. - 16

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9191 of 2023
Applicant :- Amar Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajat Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rajat Pratap Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Alok Singh, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
373 of 2022, under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Lonar,
District Hardoi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 11.09.2022 against six persons, including the applicant and his father Totaram, stating that a particular piece of land was recorded in the name of Ishwar Dayal, Prabhu and Ram Singh.
Ishwar Dayal had sold his share in favour of one Smt. Antima Devi, Prabhu had sold the share in the name of Sonkali and Ram Singh.
The informant had purchased shares of Ram Singh and Sonkali by means of a sale deed dated 22.08.2022.
On 03.09.2022, co-accused Totaram executed a sale deed in favour of co-accused Antima Devi and the applicant had witnessed execution of the sale deed.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Totaram, has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 07.04.2023 passed by a coordinate bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 1112 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 1112 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that when the executant of the sale deed has already been granted bail, the applicant who has merely witnessed its execution is also entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023
Preeti.
